SIZE:

Peach
Family  Rosaceae
Scientific name Prunus persica
Common name peach
♥A good source of vitamin A
(beta-carotene) and vitamin C
Uses
Peaches that are slightly soft to firm when
pressed and are free of blemishes or soft
spots should be chosen.  To hasten the
ripening process, underripe peaches can
be left in a loosely closed paper bag at
room temperature for 2 to 3 days.  Once
ripe, they can be kept at room tempera-
ture for about 3 to 4 days or slightly
longer in the refrigerator. 
For cooking purposes, the skin of a
peach can be easily peeled by blanching
for 30 seconds.
